bare_revenue.description: Bare revenue or ticket revenue is ambiguous; ask which metric is intended.

best_event.description: Best event requires an explicit ranking metric and a period when none is supplied.

how_are_sales_doing.description: How are sales doing requires metric, period, and a comparison baseline when a trend judgment is requested.

sold_out.description: Bare sold out is ambiguous between ever sold out and currently sold out.

notes: Timestamps are America/New_York business-local wall-clock values with no UTC suffix or offset.
Event-performance questions usually filter by events.event_date.
Purchase questions filter by orders.purchased_at.
events.event_date and orders.purchased_at must not be interchanged.
upcoming means event_date >= as_of and status = scheduled; inclusive of the as_of date.

join_guidance.note: Each event belongs to one venue.
Each ticket tier belongs to one event.
Each order item belongs to one order.
Each order item references one ticket tier; join through tiers to reach events.
Each refund references one order item; pre-aggregate refunds by order_item_id before joining to lines.

attendance_rate.description: Completed-event attendance divided by that event's released capacity.
attendance_rate.expression: events.attendance / events.capacity for completed events only
notes: Dimensionless ratio.
Basis-point rendering allowed only with proven dimensionless semantics.
Integer basis-point rounding follows the frozen nonnegative round-half-up rule.

average_ticket_price.description: Quantity-weighted actual paid price over completed orders.
average_ticket_price.expression: gross_ticket_revenue / tickets_sold, round half up to nearest integer cent
notes: Numerator is gross ticket revenue; denominator is tickets sold.
Never use AVG(unit_price_cents).
Never use face_value_cents.

currently_sold_out.description: Event is currently sold out when retained tickets meet or exceed released capacity.
notes: Uses events.capacity, never venues.capacity.
Bare sold out requires clarification versus ever_sold_out.

ever_sold_out.description: Event ever sold out when issued tickets meet or exceed released capacity.
notes: Uses events.capacity, never venues.capacity.
Bare sold out requires clarification versus currently_sold_out.

gross_ticket_revenue.description: Completed-order ticket sales before refunds, at actual paid price.
notes: Equivalent to SUM(unit_price_cents * quantity).
Never uses face_value_cents.
Includes completed-order sales for cancelled events before refunds.

net_ticket_revenue.description: Gross ticket revenue minus refunded ticket revenue.
notes: Completed-order base.
Refunds must be pre-aggregated by order_item_id before joining.

refunded_ticket_revenue.description: Refund money associated with completed-order lines.
refunded_ticket_revenue.expression: SUM(refund_amount_cents) over refunds on completed-order lines, pre-aggregated by order_item_id
notes: Affects net revenue; independent of refunded_qty.
Refunds must be pre-aggregated by order_item_id before joining.

tickets_net.description: Tickets sold minus completed-order refunded quantity.
tickets_net.expression: tickets_sold - SUM(refunded_qty) over completed-order refunds pre-aggregated by order_item_id
notes: refunded_qty affects tickets_net; refund_amount_cents does not.
Refund quantities must be pre-aggregated by order_item_id.
Cancelled orders are excluded.
Distinct from tickets_net and from attendance.

attendance.description: Turnstile attendance count for a completed event; not tickets sold.
notes: Available only for completed events; NULL otherwise.

capacity.description: Released capacity for this specific event; sold-out calculations use this column.
notes: May be lower than venues.capacity.
Sold-out calculations use events.capacity, never venues.capacity.

category.description: Event category domain: basketball, hockey, concert, comedy, or family.

event_date.description: Business calendar date generated from start_local; use for event-performance and upcoming filters.
notes: Generated from start_local; analytically useful.

start_local.description: Business-local wall-clock start timestamp without offset.

status.description: Event lifecycle domain: scheduled, completed, or cancelled.
notes: Cancelled events remain in gross ticket revenue; refunds reduce net.
Attendance is present exactly when status is completed.

events.description: One row is one event occurrence with status, category, released capacity, and optional attendance.
notes: Attendance is a turnstile count, not tickets sold.
event_date is generated from start_local.
Sold-out calculations use events.capacity.

line_gross_cents.description: Generated line total: unit_price_cents multiplied by quantity. Already the product of paid price and quantity; do not multiply by quantity again.
notes: Revenue input together with unit_price_cents.
Face value is not a revenue input.

quantity.description: Number of tickets represented by this line; multiple individual tickets are not separate rows.

unit_price_cents.description: Actual paid price per ticket in cents. The only price input to revenue. May be zero for complimentary tickets.
notes: Never substitute face_value_cents when computing revenue metrics.

order_items.description: One row represents a quantity of tickets for one tier in one order; individual tickets are not modeled as separate rows.
notes: line_gross_cents is generated as unit_price_cents * quantity.
unit_price_cents and line_gross_cents are revenue inputs; face value is not.

channel.description: Sales channel domain: web, mobile_app, box_office, or partner.

order_ref.description: Display-only order reference string; excluded from ordinary model prompt context.
notes: Display-only.

purchased_at.description: Business-local purchase timestamp; represents purchase time, not event time.

status.description: Order state domain: completed or cancelled.
notes: Only completed orders contribute to revenue and tickets sold.
Cancelled orders are excluded from analytical sales metrics.

orders.description: One row is one purchase transaction.
notes: Only completed orders contribute to revenue and tickets sold.
Cancelled orders are excluded from analytical sales metrics.
order_ref is display-only and excluded from normal model prompt context.

order_item_id.description: Refunded order-item foreign key; multiple refund rows may apply to one order item.
notes: Pre-aggregate by order_item_id before joining to lines.

reason.description: Refund reason domain: customer_request, event_cancelled, or duplicate_purchase.

refund_amount_cents.description: Money returned in cents; affects net revenue and is independent of refunded_qty.
notes: Independent of refunded_qty.
A complimentary ticket may have positive refunded_qty and zero refund amount.

refunded_qty.description: Tickets returned; affects tickets_net and is independent of refund_amount_cents.
notes: Independent of refund_amount_cents.
A complimentary ticket may have positive refunded_qty and zero refund amount.

refunds.description: One row is one refund transaction against an order item; multiple refund rows may apply to one order item.
notes: Refund data must be pre-aggregated by order_item_id before joining to lines.
refunded_qty affects tickets_net; refund_amount_cents affects net revenue.
The two measures are intentionally independent.
Completed-order filtering applies to refunded-revenue metrics.

event_id.description: Owning event foreign key; tier_name uniqueness is scoped to this event.

face_value_cents.description: Descriptive list price in cents. Never used in any revenue metric.
notes: Descriptive only. Never used in any revenue metric.

tier_name.description: Seating-tier name within one event; not globally unique.
notes: Uniqueness is scoped to event_id.
Grouping by tier_name across events combines distinct offerings.

ticket_tiers.description: One row is one ticket offering for one event. No individual-ticket identity is modeled.
notes: tier_name is unique only within an event_id.
face_value_cents is descriptive list price and must never be used as revenue.

capacity.description: Venue physical maximum capacity across configurations; not the sold-out denominator for an event.
notes: Physical maximum.
Venue capacity is not the sold-out denominator for an event.

venues.description: One row is one physical venue with a building-level capacity maximum.
notes: capacity is the venue physical maximum.
Venue capacity is not the sold-out denominator for an event.

relative_time_of_day.description: Questions that depend on a current time within as_of are unsupported because as_of is a date with no current time.
